## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the approved scope using a public-safe reference.

## Verification

List commands, results and known limitations, including `mise run pr:check`.

## Review artifact

For application changes: demo URL or command, commit and acceptance steps.
For documentation or repository setup: files to review and validation results.

## Reviews

Record code/spec review outcomes and CodeRabbit feedback resolution. Keep private review transcripts outside this PR.
